evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Design, build and maintain metrics and reports on program health
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD has no explicit rigour vocabulary (testing, governance, compliance) or velocity vocabulary (fast-paced, ship quickly); responsibilities read as standard reporting/analysis work, defaulting to mixed with weak signal either way.
evidence.domain_risk: working with one of the world's largest datasets
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect program/marketing performance measurement and customer behaviour analysis, not financial reporting or regulatory compliance, so this is low domain risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: one of the world's largest datasets
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: No named data sub-teams, infrastructure-building language, or 'first hire'/greenfield signals are present; the JD gives no clear maturity signal either way, defaulting to mid on the strength of 'large-scale complex datasets' implying existing infrastructure.
evidence.jd_authorship: Statistical testing of A/B and multivariate experiments
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Most bullets are generic ('respond to ad hoc requests', 'employ data mining, model building, segmentation') that could describe many analyst roles, with only 'A/B and multivariate experiments' being specific, so this reads as recruiter-authored boilerplate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Evaluation of the performance of program features and marketing content along measures of customer response, use, conversion, and retention
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Responsibilities span marketing/program performance (commercial) and ad hoc business-leader requests (internal) with no single dominant audience, so this is mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Respond to ad hoc requests from business leaders to investigate critical aspects of customer behavior
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are support/response-oriented ('respond to', 'participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions') rather than direction-setting, indicating execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-related responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD contains no mention of testing, data contracts, observability, or data quality frameworks in any form.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in delivery/capability and analysis terms with no risk, compliance, or reliability register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build and maintain metrics and reports on program health
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role maintains and builds on existing reporting/metrics infrastructure rather than establishing a new function, so this is fix_scale.
evidence.urgency: 6 months contract with possibility of extension or become permanent
